content: This cycle corrected a mistake I was about to make: I proposed building a whole new pmcro-loop plugin based only on the reference doc's description, without checking the actual source it was ported from. The user pushed back and pointed me at pmcro-skills-lagacy directly -- investigating it showed the real mechanism is much simpler (hand-authored markdown records per a schema, no dedicated plugin), which is what the user meant by 'reflector provides earned constraints.' Ported the four schema docs verbatim with honest adaptation notes about what does not exist here (the plugin, the cycle-/retro- trail-id convention, discover-capabilities), created the empty directories, and lightly corrected two older reference docs that still pointed at the nonexistent plugin so nothing in the corpus contradicts the new schema docs. Deliberately did not port any of the legacy repo's own populated records, and did not build any script -- exactly what was asked, nothing more. No next_seed: this closes the gap the user asked about; a constraint/product/gap/composition record gets written the first time a future cycle actually earns one, not speculatively now.
